title: 第25章 第九宫的长老第26章 本命蛊的进化方向
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
皇甫南死后的第十天。
第九宫内门的人来了。
来了一位八转境的长老，和两个五转境的弟子，开始全力调查皇甫南的死因。
例行检查很快就查到了小竹林残蛊楼。
“长老，残蛊楼的管事是一位三转蛊师，名为李元，还配了一个二转蛊师，叫王昭昭。”
“也就是那个炼化了珍蛊血眼蛊的弟子。”
“执法团调查过了，都没什么问题。”
负责陪同第九宫长老搜集线索的是百事堂堂主蚩显。
“李元是个老实人，兢兢业业做事，脚踏实地炼蛊，绝不会做违背宗门规矩的事。”
蚩显对李元印象很好。
年轻小伙一个顶俩，让他省去了向第九宫申请调人，避免了月例降低的惨痛。
“三转蛊师？”
第九宫长老皱眉，“显堂主，看来你们十二洞的人都上报不积极啊。”
蚩显一愣，“长老此话何意？”
第九宫长老似笑非笑，“依我所见，残蛊楼里两位分明是一个四转蛊师和一个三转蛊师。”
“啊？”
蚩显震惊，“都突破了？竟然不告诉我！”
“你也不必慌张。”
第九宫长老轻笑一声，“区区一个四转蛊师和三转蛊师，还做不到杀掉皇甫南而不留痕迹。”
蚩显猜测皇甫南是被一位高阶蛊师或武者所杀。

不然以皇甫南的能力不会连反抗能力没有。
他们仔仔细细检查了皇甫南居住的府邸，是真的一丝战斗痕迹都没有，足以见得幕后真凶手段之高超。
“不过这两弟子天赋不错，倒是值得培养。”
第九宫长老并不是很在乎皇甫南的死，调查只是例行公事。
相反，发现两个不错的苗子更让他开心，才算不虚此行。
“你去把他们叫来吧。”
第九宫长老吩咐。
“是。”
蚩显心里乐开了花。
要是李元和王昭昭能被长老看中，拜入第九宫内门，他作为百事堂主，功劳不小，分红也不会少。
他快步来到残蛊楼。
“李元，你什么时候踏入的四转之境？都不说一声。”
蚩显比以往更热情了。
“才突破没多久。”
李元心头一沉，没想到第九宫长老一眼就看穿了他的境界，好在他没用幻罗衣，否则极有可能暴露。
“来自第九宫的玉衡川长老点名要见你和王昭昭。”
content_en:
The tenth day after Huangfunan's death.
The people from the inner gate of the Ninth Palace are here.
An eighth-level elder and two fifth-level disciples came and began to investigate the cause of Huangfunan's death.
A routine inspection quickly found the Xiaozhulin Cangu Tower.
"Elder, the manager of the Can Gu Tower is a Level 3 Gu Master named Li Yuan, and he is also paired with a Level 2 Gu Master named Wang Zhaozhao."
"That is, the disciple who refined the precious blood eye Gu."
"The law enforcement team has investigated and there are no problems."
The person responsible for accompanying the elders of the Ninth Palace to collect clues is Chi Xian, the leader of Pepsi Hall.
"Li Yuan is an honest man. He works conscientiously and practices Gu in a down-to-earth manner. He will never do anything that violates the sect's rules."
Chi Xian had a good impression of Li Yuan.
The young man helped each other, which saved him from applying to the Ninth House for a transfer, and avoided the pain of a monthly decrease.
"Level 3 Gu Master?"
The elder of the Ninth Palace frowned and said, "Master Xian Hall, it seems that none of you in the Twelve Caves are active in reporting."
Chi Xian was stunned, "What does the elder mean by this?"
The elder of the Ninth Palace seemed to be smiling but not smiling, "From what I can see, the two people in the Can Gu Tower are clearly a Level 4 Gu Master and a Level 3 Gu Master."
"Huh?"
Chi Xian was shocked, "You broke through? You didn't even tell me!"
"You don't have to panic."
The elder of the Ninth Palace chuckled, "A rank four Gu Master and a rank three Gu Master can't kill Huangfunan without leaving any traces."
Chi Xian guessed that Huangfunan was killed by a high-level Gu master or warrior.
Otherwise, given Huangfunan's ability, he would not even have the ability to resist.
They carefully inspected the mansion where Huangfunan lived, and found that there was really no trace of the battle, which was enough to show the superb skills of the real murderer behind the scenes.
"However, these two disciples have good talents and are worth cultivating."
The elders of the Ninth Palace didn't care much about Huangfunan's death. The investigation was just a routine matter.
On the contrary, finding two good young people made him even happier, which made the trip worthwhile.
"Go and fetch them."
The elder of the Ninth Palace ordered.
"Yes."
Chi Xian felt happy.
If Li Yuan and Wang Zhaozhao can be favored by the elders and enter the inner gate of the Ninth Palace, he will have a lot of credit as the leader of Pepsi Hall and his dividends will not be small.
He quickly came to the Can Gu Tower.
"Li Yuan, when did you enter the fourth realm? You didn't even say a word."
Chi Xian was more enthusiastic than before.
"It hasn't been long since we broke through."
Li Yuan's heart sank. He didn't expect the elder of the Ninth Palace to see through his realm at a glance. Fortunately, he didn't use Huanluo Yi, otherwise he would be very likely to be exposed.
"Elder Yu Hengchuan from the Ninth Palace asked to see you and Wang Zhaozhao."
